about: P1 R1 FINAL: her body from OUR form library (tools/body/designed/*.json) over her_sliders.json: the neck and trapezius (neck_length, trap_drop, neck_girth, neck_fair), shoulder_span, the designed breast (chest_wall + breast_a, route a picked by the clay judge) and the hourglass + glute_form (route a) in place of MakeHuman's bust, buttock, waist and hips targets. bone_sliders keep her skeleton (the retired MakeHuman soft targets it was fitted with) until it is refit. shapes: the armor's breast support as blend shapes (form_support_*; P1Jiggle.SetSupport). The bake is on (inherited from her_sliders).

skin_why: the placeholder skin on her body (not her head) until R4: the skin's own rim term and glancing sheen drew the lit arcs at the Look over the breast tops, the cleavage and the armpit fold, with the rig's back lamps on or off (P1 R1 round 7, game test shots r1c/round7/lamp)
